title: Client / Employer Representative
purpose: Client / Employer representative receiving formal project deliverables, managing client reviews, and issuing formal contractual acceptance or rejection.
authority_statements: Viewer / Member access in ACC (read-only across governed deliverable folders)
Authority to participate in formal milestone review workflows
Authority to issue contractual acceptance or rejection on behalf of Appointing Party
No write access in design authoring or administrative folders
responsibilities: Review formal deliverables submitted via ACC Transmittals
Provide consolidated client feedback within agreed contractual review periods
Confirm contractual milestone acceptance against Employer's Information Requirements (EIR)
accountabilities: Timely review and formal acceptance decisions on contractual deliverables
approvals: Contractual acceptance of milestone deliverables and final handover packages
inputs: Formally transmitted deliverable packages from Project Director / Project Manager
outputs: Client review decisions (Approved, Approved as Noted, Rejected)

provenance.migration_note: Role definition migrated from the extracted governed role corpus and normalized according to accepted curator decisions.
